summary: Rallybio Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a material definitive agreement to acquire Avenzo Therapeutics, Inc. via a merger. Under the Agreement and Plan of Merger, Rallybio's wholly-owned subsidiary will merge into Avenzo, with Avenzo surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary. Avenzo shareholders will receive shares of Rallybio common stock based on an Exchange Ratio; each Avenzo option will convert into a Rallybio option. The transaction is intended to be tax-free. Terms such as price, premium, and advisors are not disclosed. The merger has been approved by both boards. Closing is subject to customary conditions. Watch for stockholder approvals and regulatory clearance; risk-arb spread will reflect deal certainty.
